name: Treatment Of Employees
overview: Scripture commands fair and honest treatment of employees, emphasizing timely payment of wages and prohibiting defrauding or oppressing hired servants, whether they are fellow Israelites or foreigners (Leviticus 19:13; Deuteronomy 24:14). Justice must be impartial and fearless, giving equal hearing to all regardless of status, as judgment ultimately belongs to God (Deuteronomy 1:17). Additionally, integrity in business dealings is mandated, forbidding dishonest measures and weights (Deuteronomy 25:13). These instructions reflect God's desire for righteousness and fairness in employer-employee relationships.
